map.→ 打开活动（策划/执行/评估）全案工具: -> Open the event (planning / execution / evaluation) full-case tool
map.一场线下活动收官后，按目标设定、预算、受众、渠道、执行、效果 6 个维度各打 0: After an offline event wraps up, score six dimensions - goal setting, budget, audience, channel, execution and effect - 0-5 each to quantify the quality of the whole plan.
map.不合格的活动数据能直接对外汇报吗？: Can failed event data be reported externally as is?
map.不建议直接对外。不合格分通常表示「达到基本标准需改进」甚至「存在较大问题」，对内: Not recommended as is. A failing score usually means "meets the basic standard but needs improvement" or even "has substantial problems". It is input for internal review; externally you should present an improved version or a sanitised summary of results. Scores from this tool serve only as an internal quality yardstick.
map.同一活动在策划稿（事前）与复盘（事后）两次评分对比，看执行是否打折。: Compare the two scores for the same event, from the plan (beforehand) and the review (afterwards), to see whether execution delivered less than planned.
map.对公关活动从策划到执行再到评估的全流程进行结构化评分，涵盖目标设定、预算管理、受: Structured scoring of the whole public relations process from planning through execution to evaluation, covering 6 dimensions: goal setting, budget management, audience analysis, channel strategy, execution quality and effect evaluation.
map.把多个活动的评分做横向排名，识别哪类活动（发布会/快闪/沙龙）稳定高分、可复制。: Rank the scores of several events side by side to identify which event type (launch / pop-up / salon) consistently scores high and is reproducible.
map.本工具等权（每项 0~5、共 30）。实际管理中效果评估往往更关键，若你要加权（: This tool weights all dimensions equally (each 0-5, 30 in total). In real management the effect evaluation is often more critical; if you want weighting (say effect at 30%), you can reinterpret the weights after computing the total, or let the weighting show up in the item scores. Equal weighting suits quick side-by-side comparison.
map.评分维度权重都一样吗？: Are the weights of the scoring dimensions the same?
map.：6 个维度各 0~5 分：①目标设定 ②预算管理 ③受众分析 ④渠道策略 ⑤执: : six dimensions scored 0-5 each: 1) goal setting, 2) budget management, 3) audience analysis, 4) channel strategy, 5) execution quality and 6) effect evaluation. Total = sum of the six, maximum 30. Grades: 25 and above excellent, 20 and above good, 15 and above pass, below 15 fail.
map.：某发布会评分 目标5+预算5+受众4+渠道5+执行5+效果4 = 28 分，判: : a launch event scores goal 5 + budget 5 + audience 4 + channel 5 + execution 5 + effect 4 = 28, judged excellent (25 or above), and the tool recommends reusing it as a benchmark case. By contrast a hastily organised market scores goal 2 + budget 2 + audience 1 + channel 2 + execution 1 + effect 1 = 9, judged a fail (below 15), with the recommendation to re-evaluate the plan. Most of the gap between 28 and 9 comes from audience analysis and execution quality, which is the review focus.
